cause: Independent audit initially required equality at every lock HEAD. Physical snapshots can contain uncommitted round changes while HEAD still names the preceding round; that assertion was too strong.
observation: AssertionError in preliminary independent audit at lock-head equality check; no independent PASS record was published.
resolution: Verify exact current repository identity in the first commit carrying both the lock pin and implementation, and separately retain differing earlier HEAD identities and their ancestry. No preimage or baseline identity changed.
